design_philosophy: Strictly structural, hyper-minimal, near-black/white monochromatic aesthetic matching emergent.sh. Gradients are completely removed. Reliance on sharp borders, generous whitespace, stark typography, and monospace accents.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous padding inside containers. Elements breathe. Sharp 1px borders define structure instead of drop shadows.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8 for standard containers. p-12 for page headers.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Universal use of border-border (zinc-200). Avoid rounded-lg or larger; stick to rounded-sm (0.25rem).

buttons.primary: bg-zinc-950 text-white rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-zinc-600 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-950 transition-colors active:scale-[0.98]

badges.philosophy: Do NOT use filled colored backgrounds to avoid 'rainbow overload'. Use outline badges with a single colored dot.
badges.container: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm border border-zinc-200 bg-transparent text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider

sidebar.container: w-64 border-r border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/50 flex flex-col h-screen
sidebar.logo_lockup: p-6 flex items-center gap-3. Use a pure black square or minimal grid SVG icon. Text is 'Emergent Labs' in General Sans, no gradients. 'Labs' can be in JetBrains Mono text-zinc-500 text-xs uppercase.
sidebar.nav_item: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 mx-2 rounded-sm text-sm font-medium transition-colors group

login.layout: Centered stark card on a pure white background. Minimalist. Container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto p-8 bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-sm shadow-sm
login.headline: Left-aligned, text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-950. Remove all gradients. 'Sign in to Emergent.'
login.demo_helper: mt-8 p-4 bg-zinc-50 border border-zinc-200 border-dashed rounded-sm font-mono text-xs text-zinc-600 space-y-2. Clearly labels 'Demo Credentials' with a small copy icon.
login.inputs: bg-transparent border-zinc-200 rounded-sm focus:ring-1 focus:ring-zinc-950 focus:border-zinc-950

dashboard.kpi_cards: Flat cards, 1px border. Values in JetBrains Mono for a highly technical, precise feel. Small monochrome sparklines.
dashboard.charts: Recharts styling: stroke='#0A0A0A' for primary lines. Hide grid lines or make them extremely faint stroke='#F4F4F5'. Tooltips should have stark black backgrounds with white text.
dashboard.tables: Dense, clean. Header row uses font-mono text-xs uppercase text-zinc-500. Row borders are border-zinc-100.

pipeline.column_header: flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-zinc-200. Title in font-mono uppercase text-xs font-semibold.
pipeline.card: bg-white p-4 border border-zinc-200 rounded-sm shadow-sm hover:border-zinc-300 transition-colors cursor-grab

micro_interactions.buttons: Subtle scale down active:scale-[0.98] with fast transition.
micro_interactions.hover_states: Background color shifts (white to zinc-50). No heavy drop shadows on hover. Keep it flat.
micro_interactions.transitions: Use transition-colors duration-150 ease-out for interactive elements.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on their role.

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace index.css :root with the specific CSS variables provided.
Update tailwind.config.js to set radius to 0.25rem.
Remove all references to bg-gradient-to-r, from-blue, via-indigo, to-violet in the entire app.
Convert General Sans heading classes to text-zinc-950 tracking-tight.
Implement the 'outline + dot' style for all Pipeline, Lead, and Priority badges to remove rainbow effect.
For the Login page, ensure the demo helper is styled like a code block (mono, gray bg, dashed border).
On charts (Recharts), strip out colorful palettes and use a monochromatic scale (zinc-900, zinc-500, zinc-300).
All components must be .js files not .tsx.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and forms.
